data.name: Acute DAPT recommendation
data.scope: Treatment-selection source screen; full explicit input review required
data.limits: Adult source-specific screening requires complete age, timing, mechanism, hemorrhage, reperfusion, anticoagulation and contraindication review. An unmatched trial branch does not select a treatment.

data.name: ABCD²
data.scope: Reviewed instrument score or grade only; no treatment selection or individualized prognosis
data.limits: For a clinically diagnosed TIA. Historical symptoms and duration need explicit review; the score does not diagnose TIA or determine disposition.

data.name: CHA₂DS₂-VASc
data.scope: Reviewed instrument score or grade only; no treatment selection or individualized prognosis
data.limits: For nonvalvular atrial fibrillation. Sex category follows the original instrument; no annual risk estimate or anticoagulant choice is generated.

data.name: HAS-BLED
data.scope: Reviewed instrument score or grade only; no treatment selection or individualized prognosis
data.limits: Original AF bleeding instrument. Review its definitions, including renal/liver impairment and labile INR. A score does not justify withholding anticoagulation; no bleeding probability is generated.

data.name: RoPE
data.scope: Reviewed instrument score or grade only; no treatment selection or individualized prognosis
data.limits: For otherwise cryptogenic ischemic stroke with PFO, not undifferentiated symptoms or TIA. The score does not establish causality or recommend closure.

data.name: PASCAL
data.scope: Reviewed instrument score or grade only; no treatment selection or individualized prognosis
data.limits: Simplified three-category classification for the source population aged 18–60 with otherwise cryptogenic stroke and PFO. Shunt/ASA definitions require specialist review; category does not establish individual causality or closure benefit.

data.name: PHASES
data.scope: Reviewed instrument score or grade only; no treatment selection or individualized prognosis
data.limits: For an unruptured saccular intracranial aneurysm. Geographic groups follow the original cohorts and must be explicitly selected. Score only; no rupture probability or management recommendation.

data.name: Modified Rankin scale descriptors
data.scope: Reviewed instrument score or grade only; no treatment selection or individualized prognosis
data.limits: Describes the existing baseline mRS entry; does not assign a grade from an interview or forecast recovery. Original descriptor wording retained in paraphrase; primary full-text review remains limited.

data.name: Hunt–Hess grade
data.scope: Reviewed instrument score or grade only; no treatment selection or individualized prognosis
data.limits: Clinician-assigned SAH grade. Descriptions are an aid, not an examination or individualized prognosis; clinical confounders require review.

data.name: WFNS grade
data.scope: Reviewed instrument score or grade only; no treatment selection or individualized prognosis
data.limits: SAH grade from complete Encounter GCS and reviewed motor deficit. The original table leaves GCS 15 with motor deficit unclassified here. No mortality or recovery prediction.

data.name: ASPECTS regional worksheet
data.scope: Reviewed instrument score or grade only; no treatment selection or individualized prognosis
data.limits: One MCA hemisphere on source-appropriate imaging. All ten regions require explicit review. Worksheet arithmetic is separate from image interpretation and EVT eligibility.

data.name: pc-ASPECTS regional worksheet
data.scope: Reviewed instrument score or grade only; no treatment selection or individualized prognosis
data.limits: Original posterior-circulation CT/CTA-source-image instrument. All eight regions require explicit review; pons and midbrain each subtract two points. No universal treatment cutoff or prognosis.

data.name: PHQ-2
data.scope: Reviewed instrument score or grade only; no treatment selection or individualized prognosis
data.limits: Two-week symptom-frequency screening, not a depression diagnosis. Both responses must be entered; no management plan is generated.

data.name: STOP-BANG
data.scope: Reviewed instrument score or grade only; no treatment selection or individualized prognosis
data.limits: Original eight-item sleep-apnea screening instrument, initially studied in surgical patients. Age, sex and BMI use Encounter values. Screening score only; no diagnosis, severity prediction or management plan.

data.name: Modified Fisher grade
data.scope: Reviewed instrument score or grade only; no treatment selection or individualized prognosis
data.limits: For aneurysmal SAH: select SAH and its aneurysmal cause in Encounter. Grade the admission CT using clinician-reviewed blood thickness and IVH. No numerical thickness cutoff, vasospasm probability or prognosis is assigned.

data.name: mTICI reperfusion grade
data.scope: Reviewed instrument score or grade only; no treatment selection or individualized prognosis
data.limits: Describes the recorded mTICI grade in an acute ischemic Encounter. Uses the revision including 2c; this is not eTICI. Confirm the angiographic report and grading system. No grade is inferred from imaging text or used to predict recovery.

data.name: NASCET carotid stenosis
data.scope: Reviewed instrument score or grade only; no treatment selection or individualized prognosis
data.limits: Patent extracranial ICA only. Use minimum residual lumen and normal distal ICA diameters from the same side, measured perpendicular to the vessel; the distal reference must be beyond bulb tapering. Excludes occlusion and suspected near-occlusion. Formula: 100 × (1 − minimum/distal). Rounded to 0.1%; values above 99.9% remain below complete occlusion. No revascularization recommendation.
